Scenario / Title: Host can start/join the session up to 4 hours before the scheduled start time
Preconditions: Session type = Meeting (Collaborative) BETA; Host is assigned in Session Editor; Current time = T-4h.
Steps:
1) Go to Agenda lobby page
2) Open the session
3) Click Start/Join
Expected Result: Host enters the meeting successfully; correct session title/timer is shown; not blocked by attendee open-time rules.

Scenario / Title: Host is blocked when attempting to start/join earlier than 4 hours before start time
Preconditions: Session type = Meeting (Collaborative) BETA; Host assigned; Current time = T-4h-1m.
Steps:
1) Go to Agenda lobby page
2) Click Start/Join
Expected Result: Host cannot enter; a clear message is shown (e.g., “You can start this session 4 hours before start time”).

Scenario / Title: Attendee cannot join before the configured attendee open time
Preconditions: Attendee open time is configured (e.g., 10 minutes before start); Current time is earlier than open time; Attendee is eligible for the event.
Steps:
1) Go to Agenda lobby page
2) Click Join
Expected Result: Attendee is blocked; a message/countdown indicates when the session opens.

Scenario / Title: Attendee can join starting from the configured attendee open time
Preconditions: Current time is within the attendee open window; Session is unlocked OR (if locked) a host is available to admit.
Steps:
1) Go to Agenda lobby page
2) Click Join
3) Complete pre-join (if shown)
Expected Result: Attendee enters the meeting (or waiting room if locked); no permission/timing gating errors occur.

Scenario / Title: Speaker join timing follows the intended rule (speaker behaves like attendee or host)
Preconditions: Speaker assigned in Session Editor; Attendee open time configured; clarify expected behavior for the product (speaker uses attendee open time vs host early-start).
Steps:
1) Go to Agenda lobby page
2) Click Join
Expected Result: Behavior matches the intended design: speaker is allowed/blocked based on the rule.
Notes: If spec is unclear, capture actual behavior and confirm with product.

Scenario / Title: Joining from the Agenda lobby page routes to the correct meeting session
Preconditions: Session is visible on Agenda; attendee is eligible; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Open Agenda
2) Select the correct session
3) Click Join
Expected Result: User lands in the correct session (not another one); correct title/time shown; participant count updates.

Scenario / Title: Unauthenticated or unauthorized user is blocked from joining
Preconditions: User is not authenticated OR not part of the event; user has access to a session link (if applicable).
Steps:
1) Open Agenda or join URL
2) Attempt to Join
Expected Result: User is prompted to sign in or shown access denied; user cannot enter the meeting.

Scenario / Title: Join with microphone permission blocked
Preconditions: Browser mic permission = blocked; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Join meeting
2) Try to enable microphone in pre-join or in-meeting
Expected Result: App shows clear guidance to enable permissions; mute state is correct; meeting does not crash.

Scenario / Title: Join with camera permission blocked
Preconditions: Browser camera permission = blocked; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Join meeting
2) Try to enable camera
Expected Result: App guides the user to enable permissions; user can still stay in meeting with video off; UI shows correct video-off indicators.

Scenario / Title: Select mic/camera/speaker devices in pre-join and join successfully
Preconditions: Machine has multiple audio devices or virtual devices; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Join
2) Select mic/camera/speaker
3) Enter the meeting
Expected Result: Selected devices are applied; audio/video works; device choice is not reset upon joining.

Scenario / Title: Organizer assigns Host/Speaker; users join and receive correct roles and permissions
Preconditions: Session type = Meeting (Collaborative) BETA; organizer assigned host + speaker; joining time window allows entry.
Steps:
1) Host joins
2) Speaker joins
3) Verify UI/permissions per role
Expected Result: Host sees host controls; speaker has speaker permissions; attendee does not get host-only controls. Role badge/name labels are correct.

Scenario / Title: Attendee cannot access host-only actions (lock/admit/remove/spotlight) if restricted
Preconditions: Attendee joined; host is present.
Steps:
1) Open meeting controls/menus
2) Look for host-only actions
Expected Result: Host-only actions are hidden or disabled; attendee cannot perform host-only operations via UI/API.

Scenario / Title: Organizer enables “Lock room” in Session Editor; attendee join goes to a waiting state
Preconditions: Lock room is enabled; host assigned; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Host joins
2) Attendee joins
Expected Result: Attendee does not enter immediately; sees waiting/admission UI. Host sees a pending admissions list.

Scenario / Title: Host admits attendees individually when room is locked
Preconditions: Room locked; two attendees are waiting.
Steps:
1) Host opens waiting list
2) Admit attendee A
3) Keep attendee B waiting (or deny if supported)
Expected Result: Attendee A enters and appears in people roster; attendee B remains waiting; participant count updates correctly.

Scenario / Title: If host locks the room in-meeting (if supported), new joiners are routed to waiting/admission flow
Preconditions: Host is in the meeting; room initially unlocked; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Host enables Lock
2) New attendee attempts to join
Expected Result: New attendee does not enter directly; host sees pending admission.

Scenario / Title: Attendee waiting for admission cannot bypass by refreshing the page
Preconditions: Room locked; attendee is currently waiting for admission.
Steps:
1) Refresh the page
2) Observe state
Expected Result: Attendee remains in waiting state; does not bypass lock; no unauthorized entry.

Scenario / Title: Sharing matrix: screen share permission enforced by role after joining
Preconditions: Sharing matrix set so Screen Share = Host only (example).
Steps:
1) Host joins and tries screen share
2) Speaker joins and tries
3) Attendee joins and tries
Expected Result: Only permitted roles can start screen share; others see control hidden/disabled and cannot share.

Scenario / Title: Sharing matrix: chat permissions (in-session/backstage) enforced by role after joining
Preconditions: Chat permissions configured in sharing matrix.
Steps:
1) Host/Speaker/Attendee join
2) Try sending in-session chat
3) Try backstage chat (if available)
Expected Result: Chat visibility and send permissions match configuration; unauthorized roles cannot see or cannot send.

Scenario / Title: Join with mic ON: mute state is displayed correctly to self and others
Preconditions: Attendee is allowed to unmute; devices are working.
Steps:
1) Join
2) Enable mic
3) Observe roster/tile indicators
Expected Result: Mute/unmute indicators are correct on roster and tiles ("Display if a user is Mute" works).

Scenario / Title: Join with mic OFF: default mute state is correct
Preconditions: Default join behavior (if any) results in muted state; attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Join
2) Do not enable mic
Expected Result: Attendee remains muted; icon is correct; no audio is transmitted.

Scenario / Title: Toggle webcam after joining: tile and name label update correctly
Preconditions: Attendee joined; camera permission granted.
Steps:
1) Turn camera on
2) Turn camera off
3) Turn camera on again
Expected Result: Video tile updates promptly; name labels remain visible; no freezing or stuck video.

Scenario / Title: Max 12 participants can have webcams ON simultaneously; participant #13 is blocked or forced video-off per rule
Preconditions: At least 13 users can join the session; max webcam sharing = 12.
Steps:
1) Have 12 users turn on camera
2) User #13 attempts to turn on camera
Expected Result: System enforces the limit: user #13 cannot enable camera or is forced to video-off with a clear message; existing 12 are unaffected.

Scenario / Title: When one of the 12 users turns camera off, another user can turn camera on
Preconditions: There are 12 cameras ON; one user turns camera OFF.
Steps:
1) User A turns camera off
2) User B (currently video off) turns camera on
Expected Result: User B can enable camera; the limit is still enforced correctly.

Scenario / Title: People list shows correct participants and participant count stays in sync
Preconditions: Multiple users join/leave during the test.
Steps:
1) Open People
2) Compare participant count vs roster
3) Have a user leave
4) Re-check
Expected Result: Counts are consistent and update near real-time; no ghost/duplicate users.

Scenario / Title: In-session chat send/receive works after joining
Preconditions: Chat is enabled in sharing matrix.
Steps:
1) Attendee A sends a message
2) Attendee B receives and replies
Expected Result: Messages appear in correct order; author/time metadata is correct; no leakage across sessions.

Scenario / Title: Host can lower raised hands via people roster
Preconditions: Hand raise is enabled; attendee joined.
Steps:
1) Attendee raises hand
2) Host lowers hand
Expected Result: Hand raise indicator is cleared for all users; attendee sees the updated state.

Scenario / Title: Emoji reactions (clap and others) work after joining
Preconditions: Reactions are enabled.
Steps:
1) Attendee sends a clap reaction
2) Observe overlay on tile
3) Confirm other participants can see it
Expected Result: Reaction UI displays correctly; does not break audio/video; rate limiting (if any) behaves correctly.

Scenario / Title: Host spotlights a participant; users who join later see the correct spotlight state
Preconditions: Meeting is live; host has spotlighted a speaker.
Steps:
1) New attendee joins
2) Observe layout
Expected Result: New attendee sees the same spotlight state; spotlight is not reset on join.

Scenario / Title: Dynamic PIP mode behaves correctly when joining and starting screen share (if permitted)
Preconditions: Sharing matrix permits user to share screen; user has joined.
Steps:
1) Start screen share
2) Observe PIP layout
3) Stop share
Expected Result: PIP transitions smoothly; does not block controls; layout returns correctly after stopping share.

Scenario / Title: Host removes an attendee; attendee is kicked and cannot bypass by immediate rejoin
Preconditions: Attendee joined; host has permission to remove.
Steps:
1) Host removes attendee
2) Attendee attempts to rejoin immediately
Expected Result: Attendee is removed; rejoin behavior follows policy (blocked/needs admission if locked); no bypass.

Scenario / Title: When “Allow session to be recorded” is OFF: no start/stop recording controls are shown while live
Preconditions: Session editor: recording checkbox OFF; session is live.
Steps:
1) Host joins
2) Speaker joins
3) Attendee joins
4) Look for recording controls
Expected Result: No recording controls are visible; recording cannot be started from the UI.

Scenario / Title: When “Allow session to be recorded” is ON: permitted roles can start/stop recording while live
Preconditions: Recording checkbox ON; session is live; confirm which roles are permitted to control recording.
Steps:
1) Join as a permitted role
2) Click Start Recording
3) Verify recording state
4) Click Stop Recording
Expected Result: Start/Stop works; recording state indicator is correct; joining participants are not disrupted.

Scenario / Title: Attendee cannot start/stop recording
Preconditions: Recording is enabled; attendee joined.
Steps:
1) Open meeting controls
2) Look for recording actions
Expected Result: Recording controls are hidden/disabled for attendee; attendee cannot start recording via UI/API.

Scenario / Title: Join meeting in a non-default UI language: strings are correct and layout is not broken
Preconditions: Set UI language to a supported non-default language (e.g., FR/DE/JA); attendee open time has started.
Steps:
1) Join
2) Open People/Chat/Reactions
3) Review labels and layout
Expected Result: Translations are correct; no text overflow or broken layouts; join flow works without errors.

Scenario / Title: Short network drop (10–30s) then reconnect: no duplicate roster entries and state remains reasonable
Preconditions: Attendee joined; network throttling can be simulated.
Steps:
1) Join
2) Turn camera on
3) Disable network for 20s
4) Re-enable network
5) Observe roster and chat
Expected Result: Client reconnects automatically; no duplicate/ghost users; audio/video state follows defined rules; chat still works after reconnect.

Scenario / Title: Refresh browser tab while in meeting: rejoin works and lock-room rules are respected
Preconditions: Attendee joined; room is unlocked OR locked with an admission policy.
Steps:
1) Refresh the tab
2) Observe join behavior
Expected Result: User returns to meeting; if room is locked the correct admission flow is applied; no crash.

Scenario / Title: Attendance report includes dwell time: multiple joins/leaves aggregate correctly
Preconditions: Reporting is enabled; organizer can access attendance report.
Steps:
1) Attendee joins for 5 minutes
2) Leaves for 2 minutes
3) Joins again for 3 minutes
4) View/export report
Expected Result: Total dwell time is 8 minutes (± rounding); not double-counted.

Scenario / Title: Attempt to join after session ended: shows ended state and (optionally) recording CTA
Preconditions: Session is ended; recording may or may not be available.
Steps:
1) Open Agenda
2) Click Join
Expected Result: User cannot enter live meeting; ended state is shown; if recording is available, CTA to view recording is correct.

Scenario / Title: Open the same join link in two tabs: policy prevents duplicate participants
Preconditions: Attendee already joined in Tab A.
Steps:
1) Open Tab B with the same join link
2) Observe behavior
Expected Result: System prevents duplicate participant sessions; behavior is clear (deny new tab or transfer session).

Scenario / Title: Name labels render correctly for Unicode (Vietnamese diacritics/CJK) when joining
Preconditions: User display name contains Unicode (e.g., “Nguyễn Ánh – 山田”).
Steps:
1) Join
2) Observe name label on tiles and in people roster
Expected Result: No encoding issues; consistent rendering; no incorrect truncation.

Scenario / Title: Avatar is shown when user joins with camera off (after setting an avatar)
Preconditions: User has set an avatar; user joins with camera off.
Steps:
1) Join
2) Ensure camera is off
3) Observe tile
Expected Result: Avatar is shown as the placeholder; name label remains correct; no avatar mix-ups.

Scenario / Title: Backstage chat (if available) is only visible to permitted roles (Host/Speaker) when joining
Preconditions: Backstage chat enabled; at least one attendee is also in the meeting.
Steps:
1) Speaker sends backstage message
2) Host verifies receipt
3) Attendee checks chat
Expected Result: Attendee cannot see backstage messages; host/speaker can.

Scenario / Title: YouTube video share: users who join after sharing starts see correct playback/state
Preconditions: Host is sharing a YouTube video; sharing is permitted; attendee joins afterward.
Steps:
1) Host starts YouTube share
2) Attendee joins
3) Observe video and audio
Expected Result: Late joiner sees the shared video; state (play/pause) aligns with the meeting per policy; no audio issues.
